integrity.reviewerScope: This final context independently classified all 151 rows, then reconciled the existing blind and adversarial reviews. No further reviewer was invoked under the no-delegation instruction.

selectionPolicy.mandatory: Retain all original final-review mandatory IDs, all newly reviewed no-hit controls, all raised realism-objection cases under their distinct mandatory identity, and seven original detached-adverb guards.
selectionPolicy.classBalance: Exactly 100 independently labeled hits and 100 independently labeled no-hits per check.
selectionPolicy.settings: Target ten per class per setting. Mandatory controls take precedence; compensate within the same class where mandatory counts exceed ten.
selectionPolicy.duplicates: Retain all six source duplicate pairs in full pools; select the mandatory repaired original and exclude the optional duplicate.
selectionPolicy.optionals: Within each setting/class, prefer independently novelty-eligible cliche positives, then use stable SHA-256 ID order with a recorded fixed seed.
selectionPolicy.beforeRepositorySelection: Archive corrected full pools and surplus with reviewed judgments in Git before mechanical dataset selection; the parent performs that authorized commit.

clicheNovelty.status: Feasible at this input snapshot. Repeat the protected audit after pending mixed-development additions and final selections.
